summary_md: **China AI for US Builders ([@smartsaver01](https://x.com/smartsaver01/status/2115581563706732747))** cautions against budgeting **MiniMax M3.1 Flash** as a free self-hosted model: the weights (on Hugging Face since Oct 23) are under MiniMax's community license, not Apache/MIT. The self-thread adds that it is a 428B MoE with 23B active and 1M context (~250 GB download needing a multi-GPU server), that commercial use requires attribution and notice with prior authorization above $20M revenue, and recommends the $0.15/$0.60 API unless volume or data control justify self-hosting.
relevance: License and hardware due-diligence for a max-tier open model before committing to self-hosting.
